sources.label: OpenCourseDeck Starter
sources.curriculum: A practical introduction to the local-first learning workflow.

topics.title: Build your learning library
raw: Browse courses, collect materials, and keep stable topic IDs so progress and notes remain connected.

topics.title: Capture notes and learning cues
raw: Create notes, timestamps, and review cues while studying. Everything remains stored on this device until you export it.

topics.title: Review progress and export backups
raw: Use the Progress workspace to review completion and export a portable backup before changing browsers, profiles, or devices.
